survey: A green hiking backpack in a three-quarter view. The front faces mostly toward the viewer and is turned slightly left, so the right side panel and its side pocket show at a narrow angle. The camera is slightly above the bag. The top flap and the lower front pocket each have two brown straps with metal buckles. These hang straight down the front, are spaced evenly, and shrink only slightly, which suits a face that is barely turned. A blue rolled sleeping mat lies across the top of the bag, held by two brown straps. Its right end shows the spiral as an upright ellipse that is narrower than it is tall. That matches how narrowly the bag's right side is drawn, and the roll's axis runs along the bag's top edge. The side pocket and the right shoulder strap sit on the receding side and are foreshortened to match it. The bag's base meets the floor in a slightly curved line seen from a little above, which matches the floor's horizon and the high camera. The top flap and the top of the roll are also seen from a little above, so every part agrees on one camera.
